findings.evidence: `rg` shows `public structure IntervalPartition` at line 32 and `public structure TubeData` at line 58, while `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/UniversalCovers/README.md:68-72` requests only discreteness of the fixed-endpoint fibres.
findings.fix: Remove `public` from `IntervalPartition` and `TubeData`; keep the public API at `Path.exists_isOpen_mem_subset_setOf_homotopic`, `Path.isOpen_setOf_homotopic`, and `Path.Homotopic.Quotient.instDiscreteTopology`, or expose a theorem-level tube API only if a later roadmap item explicitly needs it.
findings.issue: `IntervalPartition` and `TubeData` are declared `public` even though this file labels the partition as proof-local and the roadmap only calls for discreteness of fixed-endpoint homotopy-class fibres; exposing these raw tube witnesses commits downstream users to implementation scaffolding.

findings.evidence: `Path.Homotopic.Quotient.subpath_trans` has `@[simp]` at lines 75-79, but `subpath_self` at lines 83-87 and `subpath_zero_one` at lines 89-94 have no automation attributes.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `subpath_self` and `subpath_zero_one` if they do not introduce loops; they both rewrite quotient classes of special subpaths to simpler normal forms.
findings.issue: The public normal-form lemmas `Path.Homotopic.Quotient.subpath_self` and `subpath_zero_one` are not marked `[simp]`, although `subpath_trans` is; consumers of the public subpath quotient API will have to name these characteristic simplifications manually.

summary: The main discreteness interface is present, but the PR exposes proof-local tube machinery and leaves normal-form quotient subpath lemmas under-annotated.
